{"notes": "Visit 2 (2:00 of 10:00). Still provisional. I can't tell who placed which domino, so I'm relying on what I saw and heard, and on whether accounts agree.

Priya: The top line now runs to about x=18.6 and nearly meets the tail, which is good pace. She thanked Tom publicly for catching the nose gap and told me the same in private, so she is honest about the gap and didn't claim the catch. Last visit she seemed unaware of it, so this is a mild miss on her own checking. She delegated the fix clearly. Leadership is still solid. Next: does she inspect the tail crossing and the whole nose, as she said?

Maya: Her bottom line grew from about x=7 to x=9.4 and is dark, so it is connected to the start. Her private account matches Priya's and Tom's. She is steady and accurate, but about 9 units remain to the tail. Watch the pace and see whether she tells Leo where she stopped.

Tom: He now has three consistent sources: Priya's public thanks, Maya's account and his own. They say he found why the start only knocks about 7 dominoes and is closing the nose join. That is real impact. But the picture still shows the join as pale, so it is not done. I haven't seen him do it. Next: confirm the join is closed and the start reaches the top line. Also check his upper tail claim.

Leo: He says both tail pieces are up and he's taking the back half of the body lines. He asked Priya and Maya where they stopped so he can join them, which is good collaboration and initiative. There are pale bottom-body dominoes near x=18-22, y=13, but I can't attribute them to him. Next: do the joins actually close?

Team risk: The nose is still disconnected from the start, so none of the pale chain falls. The bottom gap is about 9 units. The tail crossing is untested."}
